# Installed-package consumers

`scripts/verify-package.ts` copies these fixtures into two isolated temporary
directories and installs the packed tarballs. Neither consumer uses repository
aliases or symlinked Cinder workspaces. Both typecheck with `strict: true` and
`skipLibCheck: false`.

- `index.html` / `main.tsx`: the existing Carbon and Relay consumer.
- `frame.html`: Frame with one prebuilt library stylesheet import.
- `tailwind.html`: the same Frame component with Tailwind CSS and its CLI pinned
  to **4.3.5**, installed only in this second consumer's generated devDependencies.
  The CLI compiles `tailwind.css`; the entrypoint imports that generated CSS instead
  of importing the library stylesheet again.
- `brand.module.css`: a real Bun CSS Module, alongside the plain-CSS recipe in
  `frame.css`.
- `composition.tsx`: exports `CompositionConsumer` and `CompositionConsumerProofs`
  for the additive field namespaces and existing shorthand/raw APIs. The shared
  `tsconfig.json` includes every `*.tsx` file in both isolated consumers.
- `composition.html` / `composition-native.tsx`: generated by
  `scripts/verify-package.ts` in the native consumer, not checked-in fixtures. The
  production entry mounts `CompositionConsumer` with one installed library
  stylesheet import. Its own Theme uses the URL's `frame-light` / `frame-dark`
  choice and the `en-US` locale.

## Field composition contracts

The composition fixture imports public package exports, not source paths. It
authors whole-tree `.Root` children and shared Label/Description/Help/ErrorMessage
parts, native leaf refs/events/render callbacks, grouped Control/Input/button
anatomy, single/multiple Select and ComboBox collections with numeric keys and rich
values, checkbox/radio groups, and segmented date/time/picker/range trees. Date-range
inputs use `start`/`end` slots; Number buttons use `decrement`/`increment`. All roots
retain RAC props and nullable slots. Native Input/textarea slots remain string-only.
The fully controlled single ComboBox synchronizes input text and selected key in
both callbacks; the verifier checks selection, clearing, and reselection against
native FormData. It uses RAC's complete accessible names and verifies the actual
input-to-listbox ID relationship. The field is scrolled fully into view before
focus so RAC's scroll dismissal is not mistaken for failed filtering.
The [package guide](../../../packages/react/README.md#additive-compound-namespaces)
lists the real per-family parts and ref targets.

Its declaration cases check RAC prop/ref compatibility, preserved raw exports,
unrestricted Root item types, native event versus root value callbacks, selection
value shapes, and DateInput's required segment-renderer children. Positive types
and `@ts-expect-error` cases describe the intended public declaration checks; only
an executed package run proves them. Callable compatibility examples preserve raw
replacement children, SearchField `inputProps.className` as a complete override,
and Select/ComboBox convenience children as option collections, not whole trees.

Frame defaults use label → persistent guidance → control → recovery, while the six
Carbon/Relay theme defaults stay unchanged. The library's attached Help reserves a
bounded one-line minimum. The separate
[Storybook Form recipe](../../../apps/storybook/stories/forms.css) reserves required
field recovery minimums of 58px, or 78px at or below a `24rem` container, at a 16px
root; long errors grow rather than clip. This composition fixture is an anatomy/API
compatibility consumer, not a completed grouped, collection, or date-family Frame
review. Form, validation, and raw RAC exports remain upstream-owned. Button still
supports seven variants; new Frame examples recommend only `primary`, `secondary`,
`ghost`, and `danger`.

## Commands and rendered review

Build and verify the package consumers:

```sh
bun run build
bun scripts/pack.ts
bun run test:package
```

For rendered review, retain the apps after a successful verification:

```sh
CINDER_KEEP_TEST_APP=1 bun run test:package
```

This test-harness option runs every assertion and prints both temporary directories
and the built-output directory. Serve that output directory with a static server;
it contains `index.html`, `frame.html`, `composition.html`, and `tailwind.html` plus
their bundled assets.
The Frame page includes light/dark and locale controls, two sibling brand recipes,
and inheritance/replacement/clearing controls for the plain-CSS dialog's appearance.
Its links exercise native pointer/Enter navigation and disabled-link tab skipping
in both Frame themes and both integrations.
Its four core Frame Button treatments are imported from the installed package and
checked for distinct appearance and the ordinary 44px minimum in both themes.
Its custom field reserves a feedback row so validation recovery does not move the
submit action during a pointer click. The unrelated host buttons own their minimum
target size; Cinder supplies neither their appearance nor size variables.

These are fixture contracts and retained historical integration checks, not newly
executed field/form acceptance results. See the
[verification record](../../../docs/verification.md) for executed evidence.

Successful runs clean up by default. Failed runs always retain both directories for
diagnosis. Remove retained directories after review.
